<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In the calculation $4 * 3 * 2 * 1$ each $*$ must be replaced by either a $+$ or a $\times$ sign.
Maggie wants to get an answer of $9$. In what order should she replace the signs?

-  $+ \times +$
-  $+ + \times$
-  $\times \times +$
-  $\times + \times$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In the calculation $4 * 3 * 2 * 1$ each $*$ must be replaced by either a $+$ or a $\times$ sign.
Maggie wants to get an answer of $9$. In what order should she replace the signs?
<emptyline>
-  $+ \times +$
-  $+ + \times$
-  $\times \times +$
-  $\times + \times$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

| **Option** | **Calculation** | **Target $9?$** |
| :---: | :--- | :---: |
| A | $4 + 3 \times 2 + 1 = 4 + 6 + 1 = 11$ | No |
| B | $4 + 3 + 2 \times 1 = 4 + 3 + 2 = 9$ | Yes |
| C | $4 \times 3 \times 2 + 1 = 24 + 1 = 25$ | No |
| D | $4 \times 3 + 2 \times 1 = 12 + 2 = 14$ | No |

Answer = B
</div>

<div class="answers">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Calculate $45412 \times 834 + 45412 \times 162 + 45412 \times 2$. 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Calculate $45412 \times 834 + 45412 \times 162 + 45412 \times 2$. 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 45412 \times 834 + 45412 \times 162 + 45412 \times 2 \\\\
&= 45412 \times \left( 834 + 162 + 2 \right) \\\\
&= 45412 \times 998 \\\\
&= 45412 \times (1000 - 2) \\\\
&= 45412 \times 1000 - 45412 \times 2 \\\\
&= 45412000 - 90824 \\\\
&= 45321176
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

&= \dfrac {2002 \times 15} {1000} \\\\
&= \dfrac {30030} {1000} \\\\
&= 30.03
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Which of these numbers is NOT a multiple of $3?$

- $12$
- $234$
- $3456$
- $45678$
- $567890$ 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Which of these numbers is NOT a multiple of $3?$
<emptyline>
- $12$
- $234$
- $3456$
- $45678$
- $567890$ 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: As we know that a number is divisible by 3, if the sum of all its digits is divisible by 3.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using that,

| Number    |         Sum                                           | Multiple of $3$
|:--------: |:----------------------------------------------------: | :-----:
|  $12$     | $1 + 2 = \red{3}$                                     |  Yes
|  $234$    | $2 + 3 + 4 = \red{9}$                                 |  Yes
|  $3456$   | $3 + 4 + 5 + 6 = \red{15}$                            |  Yes
|  $45678$  | $4 + 5 + 6 + 7 + 8 = \red{30}$                        |  Yes
|  $567890$ | $5 + 6 + 7 + 8 + 9 + 0 = \green{35}$                  |  No

Not a multiple of $3 = 567890$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$567890$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What does $2 \times 17 + 3 \times 17 + 5 \times 17 =?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What does $2 \times 17 + 3 \times 17 + 5 \times 17 =?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Using BIDMAS
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 2 \times 17 + 3 \times 17 + 5 \times 17 \\\\
&= (2 + 3 + 5) \times 17 \\\\
&= 10 \times 17 \\\\
&= 170
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

- $0.9$
- $0.17$ 
- $0.72$
- $0.73$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Add together the following, giving your answer as a DECIMAL

$\dfrac {2} {5}, \ 35\%$ and $0.604$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Add together the following, giving your answer as a DECIMAL
<emptyline>

</code></pre>

&= \dfrac {2 \times 2} {5 \times 2} + \dfrac {35} {100} + 0.604 \\\\
&= \dfrac {4} {10} + 0.35 + 0.604 \\\\
&= 0.4 + 0.35 + 0.604 \\\\
&= 1.354
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

**Question**

What is $\dfrac{7}{40}$ written as decimal?  

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is $\dfrac{7}{40}$ written as decimal?  
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {7} {40} \\\\
&= \dfrac {7 \times 25} {40 \times 25} \\\\
&= \dfrac {175} {1000} \\\\
&= 0.175
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

To be close to $400$, the number should start with $3$ (approaching from below) or $5$ (approaching from above).

For the number closest to $400$ starting with $3$, we want the largest possible value, so $385$. The difference is $400 - 385 = 15$.

For the number closest to $400$ starting with $5$, we want the smallest possible value, so $523$. The difference is $523 - 400 = 123$.

$15$ is smaller than $123$, so $385$ is the nearest.

Answer $= 385$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Write $62\%$ as a fraction in its lowest terms.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

\end{aligned}
$

- $a \ \ldots \ a = 0$

- $a \ \ldots \ a = 1$

- $a \ \ldots \ a = 2a$

- $a \ \ldots \ a = a^2$

<emptyline>

<emptyline>

</code></pre>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Write down a number that is smaller than $0.8$ and bigger than $\dfrac {5} {7}$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Write down a number that is smaller than $0.8$ and bigger than $\dfrac {5} {7}$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times (\dfrac {5} {7} + 0.8 ) \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times (0.71 + 0.8) \\\\
&= \dfrac {1} {2} \times (1.51) \\\\
&= \dfrac {1.51} {2} \\\\
&= 0.75
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Using exactly four fours, any of the operations $+ - \times \div$  make an expression whose value is $5$.

Example: 

$0 = 4 \div 4 \times 4 - 4$  

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\end{aligned}

$8 + \dfrac {7} {10}  +  \dfrac {91} {100}$  

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Work out the answer to the following, giving your answer as a decimal.

</code></pre>

\begin{aligned}
&= 8 + \dfrac {7} {10} + \dfrac {91} {100} \\\\
&= 8 + 0.7 + 0.91 \\\\

\end{aligned}

<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using the table,

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {4.55}{6.5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {4.55 \times 100}{6.5 \times 10 \times 10} \\\\
&= \dfrac {455}{65 \times 10} \\\\
&= \dfrac {7 \times 65}{65 \times 10} \\\\
&= \dfrac {7 \times \cancel{65}}{\cancel{65} \times 10} \\\\
&= \dfrac {7}{10}   \\\\
&= 0.7
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Which of the following distances is the most likely height of the Eiffel Tower in Paris? Circle your answer. 

- $1250 \ \text{m}$
- $305 \ \text{feet}$
- $300 \ \text{metres}$
- $36,000 \ \text{inches}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

- $300 \ \text{metres}$
- $36,000 \ \text{inches}$
</code></pre>

Let's convert all options to meters to compare with the typical height of the Eiffel Tower.

| **Option**            | **in $\text{m}$**                                      | **Comment**                           |
|:---------------------:|:----------------------------------------------:|:--------------------------------------|
| $1250\ \text{m}$      | $1250\ \text{m}$                               | Too tall, over $1 \ \text{km}$        |
| $305\ \text{feet}$    | $305 \times 0.3 \approx 93\ \text{m}$          | Much too short                        |
| $300\ \text{metres}$  | $300\ \text{m}$                                | Best estimate                         |
| $36,000\ \text{inches}$ | $\dfrac{36,000}{40} \approx 914\ \text{m}$ | Far too tall                          |

Answer $= 300\ \text{metres}$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Calculate $2.4 \times (3.7 +  1.3) \div 2$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Calculate $2.4 \times (3.7 +  1.3) \div 2$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Using BIDMAS
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 2.4 \times (3.7 +  1.3) \div 2 \\\\
&= 2.4 \times 5 \div 2 \\\\
&= \dfrac{2.4 \times 5}{2} \\\\
&= \dfrac{2 \times 1.2 \times 5}{2} \\\\
&= \dfrac{\cancel {2} \times 1.2 \times 5}{\cancel {2}} \\\\  
&= 1.2 \times 5 \\\\
&= 6
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$6$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Calculate $1.1 \times (1.2 + 1.3) \times 2$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Calculate $1.1 \times (1.2 + 1.3) \times 2$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Using BIDMAS
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 1.1 \times (1.2 + 1.3) \times 2 \\\\
&= 1.1 \times 2.5 \times 2 \\\\
&= 1.1 \times 5 \\\\
&= 5.5
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Put a circle around all the numbers that are between $2.2$ and $2.6$

$2 \dfrac{1}{2} \quad 2 \dfrac{1}{7} \quad 2 \dfrac{6}{11} \quad 2 \dfrac{2}{5} \quad 2 \dfrac{1}{10}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Put a circle around all the numbers that are between $2.2$ and $2.6$
<emptyline>
$2 \dfrac{1}{2} \quad 2 \dfrac{1}{7} \quad 2 \dfrac{6}{11} \quad 2 \dfrac{2}{5} \quad 2 \dfrac{1}{10}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let's convert the mixed numbers into decimals.

| Number | Decimal |  $> 2.2$ and $< 2.6$ |
| :---: | :---: | :---: |
| $2 \dfrac{1}{2}$ | $2.5$ | Yes |
| $2 \dfrac{1}{7}$ | $\approx 2.14$ | No |
| $2 \dfrac{6}{11}$ | $\approx 2.55$ | Yes |
| $2 \dfrac{2}{5}$ | $2.4$ | Yes |
| $2 \dfrac{1}{10}$ | $2.1$ | No |

Numbers in the range are $2 \dfrac{1}{2}$, $2 \dfrac{6}{11}$ and $2 \dfrac{2}{5}$.
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$2 \dfrac {1} {2} \quad 2 \dfrac {6} {11} \quad 2 \dfrac {2} {5}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Calculate $(2.3 + 3.7) \div 9$. Leave your answer as a simplified fraction.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Calculate $(2.3 + 3.7) \div 9$. Leave your answer as a simplified fraction.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">

</div>

<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= (2.3 + 3.7) \div 9 \\\\
&= \dfrac{6}{9} \\\\
&= \dfrac{2 \times 3}{3 \times 3} \\\\
&= \dfrac{2 \times \cancel{3}}{3 \times \cancel{3}} \\\\
&= \dfrac{2}{3}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

**Question**

Calculate $1.1 \times (4.5 + 2.5) - 2$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Calculate $1.1 \times (4.5 + 2.5) - 2$
</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\begin{aligned}
&= 1.1 \times (4.5 + 2.5) - 2 \\\\
&= 1.1 \times 7 - 2 \\\\
&= 7.7 - 2 \\\\
&= 5.7
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

$8 \times 3 - 10 + 6$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Using BIDMAS
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 8 \times 3 - 10 + 6 \\\\
&=  24 - 10 + 6 \\\\
&= 14 + 6 \\\\
&= 20
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If $p * 4 = 48$ find the value of $p$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If $p * 4 = 48$ find the value of $p$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
p * 4                   &= 48  \\\\
p^2 + (3 \times {4})    &= 48 \\\\
p^2 + 12                &= 48 \\\\
p^2                     &= 48 - 12 \\\\
p^2                     &= 36 \\\\
p                       &= \sqrt{36} \\\\
p                       &= \sqrt{6 \times 6} \\\\
p                       &= 6
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If $2 * q = 25$ find the value of $q$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If $2 * q = 25$ find the value of $q$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
2 * q                &= 25  \\\\
2^2 + (3 \times q)   &= 25 \\\\
4 + 3q               &=  25 \\\\
3q                   &= 25 - 4 \\\\
q                    &= \dfrac{21}{3} \\\\
q                    &= \dfrac{7 \times{3}}{3} \\\\
q                    &= \dfrac{7 \times \cancel{3}}{\cancel3} \\\\
q                    &= 7
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$7$

</div>

**Question**

If $s * t = 10$ where $s$ and $t$ are positive whole numbers, what are 
the possible values of $s\text{?}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If $s * t = 10$ where $s$ and $t$ are positive whole numbers, what are 
the possible values of $s\text{?}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
s * t           &= 10 \\\\
s ^ 2 + 3t      &= 10 \\\\
t &= \dfrac {10 - s^2} {3}
\end{aligned}
$

We can easily infer the value by using trial and error.

| $s$ | $t$ | $t$ whole number? |
|:---:|:-------------------------:|:--------------------------------:|
| $1$ | $ \dfrac{10 - 1^2}{3} = 3 $ | Yes |
| $2$ | $ \dfrac{10 - 2^2}{3} = 2 $ | Yes |
| $3$ | $ \dfrac{10 - 3^2}{3} = \dfrac{1}{3} $ | No |
| $4$ | $ \dfrac{10 - 4^2}{3} = -2 $ | No |
| $5$ | $ \dfrac{10 - 5^2}{3} = -5 $ | No |

Possible values for $s = 1, 2$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$1, 2$

</div>
</div>

<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%empty%
</code></pre>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">As per the question,
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
s * t           &= 10 \\\\
s ^ 2 + 3t      &= 10 \\\\
t &= \dfrac {10 - s^2} {3}
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
We can easily infer the value by using trial and error.
<emptyline>
| $s$ | $t$ | $t$ whole number? |
|:---:|:-------------------------:|:--------------------------------:|
| $1$ | $ \dfrac{10 - 1^2}{3} = 3 $ | Yes |
| $2$ | $ \dfrac{10 - 2^2}{3} = 2 $ | Yes |
| $3$ | $ \dfrac{10 - 3^2}{3} = \dfrac{1}{3} $ | No |
| $4$ | $ \dfrac{10 - 4^2}{3} = -2 $ | No |
| $5$ | $ \dfrac{10 - 5^2}{3} = -5 $ | No |
<emptyline>
Possible values for $s = 1, 2$
</code></pre>
</div>

**Question**

Joey has the six number cards shown below

$
\huge {
\boxed {1} 
\quad \boxed {2} 
\quad \boxed {3} 
\quad \boxed {4}
\quad \boxed {5}
\quad \boxed {8}
}
$

The number cards are to be placed next to each other to form different numbers.

For example using three of the cards you could make two hundred and fifty one like this: 

$
\huge {
\boxed {2} 
\ \boxed {5} 
\ \boxed {1}
}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Work out $(57 + 56 + 55 + 54) - (56 + 55 + 54 + 53)$ 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Work out $(57 + 56 + 55 + 54) - (56 + 55 + 54 + 53)$ 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= (57 + 56 + 55 + 54) - (56 + 55 + 54 + 53) \\\\
&= 57 + 56 + 55 + 54 - 56 - 55 - 54 - 53 \\\\
&= 57 + (56 - 56) + (55 - 55) + (54 - 54) - 53 \\\\
&= 57 - 53 \\\\
&= 4
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Use the fact that $96815 \times 123 = 11908245$ to work out $96816  \times 123$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 96816 \times 123 \\\\
&= (96815 + 1) \times 123 \\\\
&= 96815 \times 123 + 1 \times 123 \\\\
&= 11908245 + 123 \\\\
&= 11908368
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

&= 11908368
\end{aligned}

$\dfrac {1} {3}$ and $\dfrac {1} {2}$

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$\dfrac {1} {3}$ and $\dfrac {1} {2}$
</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {1}{2} \times (\dfrac {1}{3} + \dfrac {1}{2}) \\\\
&= \dfrac {1}{2} \times (\dfrac {1 \times 2}{3 \times 2} + \dfrac {1 \times 3}{2 \times 3}) \\\\
&= \dfrac {1}{2} \times (\dfrac {2}{6} + \dfrac {3}{6}) \\\\
&= \dfrac {1}{2} \times (\dfrac {5}{6}) \\\\
&= \dfrac {5}{12}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Sum} &= 1 + 2 + 4 + 7 + 14 + 28 \\\\
&= 56 \\\\
\text{Half}  &= \dfrac {56} {2} \\\\
&= \dfrac {28 \times 2} {2} \\\\
&= \dfrac {28 \times \cancel{2}} {\cancel{2}} \\\\
&= 28
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is the difference, in cm, between $3.2 \ \text{metres}$ and $30 \ \text{cm}?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is the difference, in cm, between $3.2 \ \text{metres}$ and $30 \ \text{cm}?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>

<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Difference}    &= 3.2 \ \text{m} - 30 \ \text{cm} \\\\
                     &= 3.2 \times 100 \ \text{cm} - 30 \ \text{cm} \\\\
                     &= 320 - 30   \\\\
                     &= 290  \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

                  &= 5
\end{aligned}
$

**Question**

$32 \div ( 10 - \boxed{\phantom{5}}) = 4$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the missing number $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
32 \div (10 - a)        &= 4 \\\\
\dfrac{32}{10 - a}      &= 4 \\\\
10 - a                  &= \dfrac{32}{4} \\\\
10 - a                  &= \dfrac{4 \times 8}{4} \\\\
10 - a                  &= \dfrac{4 \times \cancel 8}{\cancel 4} \\\\
10 - a                  &= 8 \\\\
a                       &= 10 - 8 \\\\
a                       &= 2
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

what is the number that is closest to $50000?$

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

To be close to $50000$, the number should start with $4$ (approaching from below) or $6$ (approaching from above).

For the number closest to $50000$ starting with $4$, we want the largest possible value, so $48762$

Difference: $50000 - 48762 = 1238$

For the number closest to $50000$ starting with $6$, we want the smallest possible value, so $62478$

Difference: $62478 - 50000 = 12478$

$1238$ is smaller than $12478$, so $48762$ is the closest.

Number $= 48762$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{aligned}
a \times 16  &= 36 \div 9 \\\\

a            &= \dfrac {9 \times 4} {9 \times 4 \times 4} \\\\
a            &= \dfrac {\cancel {9} \times \cancel {4}} {\cancel {9} \times 4 \times \cancel {4}} \\\\
a            &= \dfrac {1} {4}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is the difference between the product of $4$ and $11$ and the difference of $4$ and $11?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is the difference between the product of $4$ and $11$ and the difference of $4$ and $11?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= (4 \times 11) - (11 - 4)  \\\\
&= 44 - 7 \\\\
&= 37
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$37$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is the product of the sum of $8$ and $4$ with the difference of $3$ and $12?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\begin{aligned}
&= (8 + 4) \times (12 - 3)  \\\\
&= 12 \times 9 \\\\
&= 108
\end{aligned}
$

&= \dfrac {16432} {4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {4108 \times 4} {4} \\\\
&= \dfrac {4108 \times \cancel 4} { \cancel 4} \\\\
&= 4108
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The $\text{FAB}$ of a number is obtained by multiplying the number by all the whole numbers less than or equal to it down to one.

So $\text{FAB } 3 = 6$ because $3 \times 2 \times 1 = 6$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

**Question**

What is $\text{FAB }11$ divided by $\text{FAB } 9?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is $\text{FAB }11$ divided by $\text{FAB } 9?$
</code></pre>

<div class="workings">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {\text {FAB} \ 11} {\text {FAB} \ 9} \\\\
&= \dfrac {11 \times 10 \times \text {FAB} \ 9} {\text {FAB} \ 9} \\\\
&= \dfrac {11 \times 10 \times \cancel {\text {FAB} \ 9}} {\cancel {\text {FAB} \ 9}} \\\\
&= 11 \times 10 \\\\
&= 110
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is the product of the sum of $6$ and $3$ with the difference between $2$ and $10?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

&= (6 + 3) \times (10 - 2) \\\\
&= 9 \times 8 \\\\
&= 72
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Which sum has been set out correctly to give the answer $67?$ 

- $8 + 4 \times 6 - 5$
- $(8 + 4) \times (6 - 5)$
- $(8 + 4) \times 6 - 5$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Which sum has been set out correctly to give the answer $67?$ 
<emptyline>
- $8 + 4 \times 6 - 5$
- $(8 + 4) \times (6 - 5)$
- $(8 + 4) \times 6 - 5$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Using BIDMAS
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Option A}
&= 8 + 4 \times 6 - 5 \\\\
&= 8 + 24 - 5 \\\\
&= 32 - 5 \\\\
&= \red{27} \neq 67
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Option B}     
&= (8 + 4) \times (6 - 5) \\\\
&= 12 \times 1 \\\\
&= \red{12} \neq 67
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Option C}
&= (8 + 4) \times 6 - 5 \\\\
&= 12 \times 6  - 5 \\\\
&= 72 - 5 \\\\
&= \green{67}
\end{aligned}
$

Answer $= \text{C}$
</div>
</div>

<div class="option" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Add together the three lengths $1.4 \ \text{m}$, $33 \  \text{cm}$ and $580 \  \text{mm}$ giving your answer in cm.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>

</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

&= 140 + 33  + 58 \\\\
&= 231 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$

</div>

a &= \dfrac {19 \times 8} {19} \\\\

a &= 8 
\end{aligned}
$

**[Give your answer as a mixed number]**

&= \dfrac {88 - 23} {6} \\\\
&= \dfrac {65} {6} \\\\
&= 10 \dfrac {5} {6}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Fill in the missing digits to complete the following multiplication:

$2005 = \boxed{5} \times \boxed{\phantom{15}} \boxed{\phantom{15}} \boxed{\phantom{15}}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Fill in the missing digits to complete the following multiplication:
<emptyline>
$2005 = \boxed{5} \times \boxed{\phantom{15}} \boxed{\phantom{15}} \boxed{\phantom{15}}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the missing number $= a$

$
\begin{aligned}
2005    &= 5 \times a \\\\
a       &= \dfrac {2005} {5} \\\\  
a       &= \dfrac {5 \times 401} {5} \\\\
a       &= \dfrac {\cancel {5} \times 401} {\cancel {5}} \\\\
a       &= 401
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$401$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is $1 \dfrac {1} {2}$ times $5.6?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is $1 \dfrac {1} {2}$ times $5.6?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 1 \dfrac {1} {2} \times 5.6 \\\\
&= \dfrac {3} {2} \times 5.6 \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 5.6} {2} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 2 \times 2.8} {2} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times \cancel {2}  \times 2.8} {\cancel {2}} \\\\
&= 3 \times 2.8 \\\\
&= 8.4
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$8.4$

</div>
</div>

&= \dfrac {3 \times 5.6} {2} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times 2 \times 2.8} {2} \\\\
&= \dfrac {3 \times \cancel {2}  \times 2.8} {\cancel {2}} \\\\
&= 3 \times 2.8 \\\\
&= 8.4
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>
</div>

**Question**

The prime factorisation of $60$ is $2 \times 2 \times 3 \times 5$.

What is the prime factorisation of $56?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many grams are there in $2.5 \ \text{kg}?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many grams are there in $2.5 \ \text{kg}?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&=  2.5 \ \text{kg} \\\\
&=  2.5 \times 1000 \ \text {grams} \\\\
&=  2500 \ \text{grams}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$2500 \ \text{grams}$

**Question**

Andy has $5 \ \text{m} \ 35 \ \text{cm}$ of tape. He uses $243 \ \text{cm}$ for wrapping parcels. How many $\text{cm}$ of tape does he have left over?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>

</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\begin{aligned}
\text {Tape left}   &= 5 \ \text{m} \ 35 \ \text{cm} - 243 \ \text{cm} \\\\
                    &= 535 \ \text{cm} - 243 \ \text{cm} \\\\
                    &= 292 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

| $14$ | $14 \times 14 = 196$      | Yes |
| $15$ | $15 \times 15 = 225$      | No |

Count $= 4$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Two square numbers have a difference of $33$. Identify the two missing whole numbers that complete this calculation.

$A^2 - B^2 = 33$

Fill in the two empty boxes to show your answer:

$\boxed{\phantom{1}} \ ^2 - \boxed{\phantom{1}} \ ^2 = 33$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Two square numbers have a difference of $33$. Identify the two missing whole numbers that complete this calculation.
<emptyline>
$A^2 - B^2 = 33$
<emptyline>
Fill in the two empty boxes to show your answer:
<emptyline>
$\boxed{\phantom{1}} \ ^2 - \boxed{\phantom{1}} \ ^2 = 33$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Square numbers between $1$ and $100= 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, 36, 49, 64, 81, 100$
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

We can infer the values by using trial and error. Let's start with $6$ and go up, since $5^2 = 25$ which is less than $33$.

Let's test pairs of square numbers to find a difference of $33$.

| $A$ | $B$ | Calculation                          | $=33?$ |
|:---:|:---:|:-------------------------------------:|:-----------------:|
| $6$ | $1$ | $6^2 - 1^2 = 36 - 1 = 35$             | No |
| $6$ | $2$ | $6^2 - 2^2 = 36 - 4 = 32$             | No |
| $7$ | $1$ | $7^2 - 1^2 = 49 - 1 = 48$             | No |
| $7$ | $2$ | $7^2 - 2^2 = 49 - 4 = 45$             | No |
| $7$ | $3$ | $7^2 - 3^2 = 49 - 9 = 40$             | No |
| $7$ | $4$ | $7^2 - 4^2 = 49 - 16 = 33$            | Yes |

The pair that works is $A = 7$ and $B = 4$.

$A = 7$, $B = 4$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$7$

</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$4$

</div>
</div>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">We can infer the values by using trial and error. Let's start with $6$ and go up, since $5^2 = 25$ which is less than $33$.

| $6$ | $2$ | $6^2 - 2^2 = 36 - 4 = 32$             | No |
| $7$ | $1$ | $7^2 - 1^2 = 49 - 1 = 48$             | No |
| $7$ | $2$ | $7^2 - 2^2 = 49 - 4 = 45$             | No |
| $7$ | $3$ | $7^2 - 3^2 = 49 - 9 = 40$             | No |
| $7$ | $4$ | $7^2 - 4^2 = 49 - 16 = 33$            | Yes |

**Question**

What is the square root of $225?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Circle which of the following has a different value from the others:

- $3 - 7 - 4$
- $(3 - 7) - 4$
- $3 - (7 - 4)$
- $((3 - 7) - 4)$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Circle which of the following has a different value from the others:
<emptyline>
- $3 - 7 - 4$
- $(3 - 7) - 4$
- $3 - (7 - 4)$
- $((3 - 7) - 4)$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{A} &= 3 - 7 - 4 \\\\
         &= -8 \\\\
\text{B} &= (3 - 7) - 4 \\\\
         &= -4 - 4 \\\\
         &= -8 \\\\
\text{C} &= 3 - (7 - 4) \\\\
         &= 3 - 3 \\\\ 
         &= 0 \\\\
\text{D} &= ((3 - 7) - 4) \\\\ 
         &= (-4 - 4) \\\\
         &= -8
\end{aligned}
$

Different Value $= 3 - (7 - 4)$
</div>
</div>

</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$3 - (7 - 4)$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Add brackets to this calculation to that the answer is $5$.

$22 - 10 + 8 \div 4$

-  $22 -(10 + 8) \div 4$
-  $(22 - 10) + 8 \div 4$
-  $(22 - 10 + 8) \div 4$
-  $22 - 10 + (8 \div 4)$

</div>

<emptyline>

<emptyline>
-  $22 -(10 + 8) \div 4$
-  $(22 - 10) + 8 \div 4$
-  $(22 - 10 + 8) \div 4$
-  $22 - 10 + (8 \div 4)$
</code></pre>
</div>

\text{A}    &= 22 - (10 + 8)\div 4 \\\\
            &= 22 - 18\div 4 \\\\
            &= 22 - 4.5 \\\\
            &= \red{17.5} \neq 5 \\\\
\text{B}    &=(22 - 10) + 8 \div 4\\\\
            &= 12 + 2 \\\\
            &= \red{14} \neq 5 \\\\

            &= \green{5} \\\\

            &= \red{14} \neq 5
\end{aligned}

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Which of the following has the same remainder when it is divided by $2$
as when it is divided by $3?$

- $5$
- $7$
- $9$
- $11$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>

as when it is divided by $3?$
<emptyline>
- $5$
- $7$
- $9$
- $11$
</code></pre>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Jaishan notices that if he squares two numbers and find the difference  of his answer he gets the same result as multiplying the sum and the difference of the two number.

For example, if he chooses $9$ and $3$:   

$9 ^ {2} - 3 ^ {2} = 81 - 9 = 72$ and 

$(9 + 3) \times (9-3) = 12 \times 6 = 72$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<emptyline>
For example, if he chooses $9$ and $3$:   
<emptyline>
$9 ^ {2} - 3 ^ {2} = 81 - 9 = 72$ and 
<emptyline>
$(9 + 3) \times (9-3) = 12 \times 6 = 72$
</code></pre>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Here are three numbers
and two operations on five cards.

$\huge{ \boxed{\phantom{}3} \ \boxed{\phantom{}7} \ \boxed{24} \ \boxed{\phantom{}+} \ \boxed{\phantom{}\div} } $

Which of these gives the answer $15?$

- $24 \div 7 + 3$
- $3 + 7 \div 24$
- $7 + 3 \div 24$
- $3 \div 7 + 24$
- $24 \div 3 + 7$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Here are three numbers
and two operations on five cards.
<emptyline>
$\huge{ \boxed{\phantom{}3} \ \boxed{\phantom{}7} \ \boxed{24} \ \boxed{\phantom{}+} \ \boxed{\phantom{}\div} } $
<emptyline>
Which of these gives the answer $15?$
<emptyline>
- $24 \div 7 + 3$
- $3 + 7 \div 24$
- $7 + 3 \div 24$
- $3 \div 7 + 24$
- $24 \div 3 + 7$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Using BIDMAS
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{A}    &= 24 \div 7 + 3 \\\\
            &= \dfrac {24} {7} + 3 \\\\
            &= 3 \dfrac{3}{7} + 3 \\\\
            &= 6 \dfrac{3}{7} \neq \red{15} \\\\
\text{B}    &= 3 + 7 \div 24 \\\\
            &= 3 + \dfrac {7} {24} \\\\
            &= 3 \dfrac{7}{24} \neq \red{15} \\\\
\text{C}    &= 7 + 3 \div 24 \\\\
            &= 7 + \dfrac {3} {24} \\\\
            &= 7 + \dfrac {3} {3 \times 8} \\\\
            &= 7 + \dfrac {\cancel {3}} {\cancel {3} \times 8} \\\\
            &= 7 + \dfrac {1} {8} \\\\
            &= 7 \dfrac{1}{8} \neq \red{15} \\\\
\text{D}    &= 3 \div 7 + 24 \\\\
            &= \dfrac {3} {7} + 24 \\\\
            &= 24 \dfrac {3}{7} \neq \red{15} \\\\
\text{E}    &= 24 \div 3 + 7 \\\\
            &= \dfrac {24} {3} + 7 \\\\
            &= \dfrac {3 \times 8} {3} + 7 \\\\
            &= \dfrac {\cancel {3} \times 8} {\cancel {3}} + 7 \\\\
            &= 8 + 7 \\\\
            &= \green{15}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="option" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Option**

<p>E</p>
</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$24 \div 3 + 7$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="tipcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Tips Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">- rtq_abbr_note_md_bidmas
</code></pre>

</code></pre>

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$
\begin{aligned}
\text{A}    &= 24 \div 7 + 3 \\\\
            &= \dfrac {24} {7} + 3 \\\\
            &= 3 \dfrac{3}{7} + 3 \\\\
            &= 6 \dfrac{3}{7} \neq \rtq_abbr_working_color_wrong_answer{15} \\\\
\text{B}    &= 3 + 7 \div 24 \\\\
            &= 3 + \dfrac {7} {24} \\\\
            &= 3 \dfrac{7}{24} \neq \rtq_abbr_working_color_wrong_answer{15} \\\\
\text{C}    &= 7 + 3 \div 24 \\\\
            &= 7 + \dfrac {3} {24} \\\\
            &= 7 + \dfrac {3} {3 \times 8} \\\\
            &= 7 + \dfrac {\cancel {3}} {\cancel {3} \times 8} \\\\
            &= 7 + \dfrac {1} {8} \\\\
            &= 7 \dfrac{1}{8} \neq \rtq_abbr_working_color_wrong_answer{15} \\\\
\text{D}    &= 3 \div 7 + 24 \\\\
            &= \dfrac {3} {7} + 24 \\\\
            &= 24 \dfrac {3}{7} \neq \rtq_abbr_working_color_wrong_answer{15} \\\\
\text{E}    &= 24 \div 3 + 7 \\\\
            &= \dfrac {24} {3} + 7 \\\\
            &= \dfrac {3 \times 8} {3} + 7 \\\\
            &= \dfrac {\cancel {3} \times 8} {\cancel {3}} + 7 \\\\
            &= 8 + 7 \\\\
            &= \rtq_abbr_working_color_answer{15}
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Which of these could be the correct measurement for the length of a bus? 

- $140\ \text{m}$ 
- $1400\ \text{cm}$ 
- $140\ \text{mm}$ 
- $140 000\ \text{mm}$ 
- $0.0014\ \text{km}$ 

</div>

|  **Options** |         **in $\text{m}$**         | **Comment**                                             |
| :-----------------: | :-------------------------------------: | :------------------------------------------------------ |
| $140\ \text{m}$       | $140\ \text{m}$                             | Too long                      |
| $1400\ \text{cm}$     | $\dfrac{1400}{100} = 14\ \text{m}$          | Reasonable bus length                      |
| $140\ \text{mm}$      | $\dfrac{140}{1000} = 0.14\ \text{m}$        | Much too short                             |
| $140000\ \text{mm}$   | $\dfrac{140000}{1000} = 140\ \text{m}$      | Far too long                               |
| $0.0014\ \text{km}$   | $0.0014 \times 1000 = 1.4\ \text{m}$        | Much too short                             |

Answer $= 1400\ \text{cm}$
</div>

\begin{aligned}
600 \div a              &= 50 \\\\

a                       &= \dfrac {600} {50}  \\\\
a                       &= \dfrac {50 \times 12} {50}  \\\\
a                       &= \dfrac { \cancel {50} \times 12} {\cancel {50}}  \\\\
a                       &= 12
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

**Question**

Using all $5$ cards what is the number that is closest to $50000?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

To be close to $50000$, the number should start with $4$ (approaching from below) or $6$ (approaching from above).

For the number closest to $50000$ starting with $4$, we want the largest possible value, so $48762$

Difference: $50000 - 48762 = 1238$

For the number closest to $50000$ starting with $6$, we want the smallest possible value, so $62478$

Difference: $62478 - 50000 = 12478$

$1238$ is smaller than $12478$, so $48762$ is the closest.

Number $= 48762$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

&= \dfrac {26 + 15} {10} \\\\
&= \dfrac {41} {10} \\\\
&= 4 \dfrac {1} {10} 
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Write down two different odd prime numbers that add together to make a square number.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Write down two different odd prime numbers that add together to make a square number.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$5, 11$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

ABBR: Square numbers between $1$ and $50= 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, 36, 49$


We need $2$ different odd prime numbers that add together to make a square number.

We can easily infer the values by using trial and error.

| Square | Prime pair          | Works? |
|:------:|:-------------------:|:------:|
| $16$   | $3 + 13 = 16$       | Yes |
| $16$   | $5 + 11 = 16$       | Yes |
| $36$   | $5 + 31 = 36$       | Yes |
| $36$   | $7 + 29 = 36$       | Yes |
| $36$   | $13 + 23 = 36$      | Yes |
| $36$   | $17 + 19 = 36$      | Yes |


Answer $= (3, 13), (5, 11)$

</div>
</div>
